explanation: Compared against OEIS A216265: a(n) is the number of primes between n³ - n and n³, with the conjecture a(n) > 0 for n > 13. The definition is π(n³) - π(n³ - n), counting primes in (n³ - n, n³]. Endpoint conventions do not matter for n > 2, since n³ is not prime and n³ - n = (n-1)n(n+1) is even and composite. The tests match the data, including a(1..5). The statement asserts 0 < a n for n > 13. Faithful.
